recipe.title: Honey Butter Spread on Lemon Cake
recipe.description: This super simple honey butter spread is soft and creamy - perfect on a homemade lemon loaf. Delicious for breakfast or dessert!
instructions: Soften butter for 10-15 seconds in the microwave if it’s cold.
Pour in the honey into a bowl with the butter and stir until smooth. Add powdered sugar and stir until smooth. Add more powdered sugar for a thicker spread.
